g.text: POWER STAGE: 4-PHASE SWITCHED-RELUCTANCE MOTOR, SHARED HIGH-SIDE SWITCHES

g.desc: POWER STAGE: 4-PHASE SWITCHED-RELUCTANCE MOTOR, SHARED HIGH-SIDE SWITCHES

g.text: phases (stator, 8.5 ohm each): CN501 1-3 and 1-5 share high side Q501; 2-4 and 2-6 share high side Q502

g.desc: phases (stator, 8.5 ohm each): CN501 1-3 and 1-5 share high side Q501; 2-4 and 2-6 share high side Q502

g.text: - IGBTs Q500-Q505: G04N60 (Infineon SGP04N60-type, 600 V). Low-side emitters (LS_EMIT) return to GND through R600 // R601 (0.27 ohm each).

g.desc: - IGBTs Q500-Q505: G04N60 (Infineon SGP04N60-type, 600 V). Low-side emitters (LS_EMIT) return to GND through R600 // R601 (0.27 ohm each).

g.text: - Freewheel diodes all ~0.475 V in diode mode. IR2106 supply VGATE exists only while the safety logic enables Q205/Q206: a firmware crash or a refused

g.desc: - Freewheel diodes all ~0.475 V in diode mode. IR2106 supply VGATE exists only while the safety logic enables Q205/Q206: a firmware crash or a refused

g.text: permit removes ALL gate drive. Discrete drivers: MCU pin high = IGBT off; turn-on through 470 ohm, fast turn-off through 47 ohm + diode.

g.desc: permit removes ALL gate drive. Discrete drivers: MCU pin high = IGBT off; turn-on through 470 ohm, fast turn-off through 47 ohm + diode.

g.text: - Hardware overcurrent cut-off: IC610 pulls TRIP low; D512/D513 force both HIN inputs low (high sides off without firmware) and interrupt the MCU (pin 45).

g.desc: - Hardware overcurrent cut-off: IC610 pulls TRIP low; D512/D513 force both HIN inputs low (high sides off without firmware) and interrupt the MCU (pin 45).

g.text: - APPROXIMATE: bootstrap diodes (D514/D517 drawn; D518/D519 also exist); HO gate resistors and Q503/Q504 gate pull-downs not traced;

g.desc: - APPROXIMATE: bootstrap diodes (D514/D517 drawn; D518/D519 also exist); HO gate resistors and Q503/Q504 gate pull-downs not traced;

g.text: the ~33 ohm feed RX11 may be two resistors; DX2 = turn-off diode of Q505 (reference not read).

g.desc: the ~33 ohm feed RX11 may be two resistors; DX2 = turn-off diode of Q505 (reference not read).

g.text: MCU: pin 1 HIN1, 2 LIN1, 3 HIN2, 4 LIN2
